risks.title: Dependence on financial partners
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, mentioned early and repeated. The language is strong ("materially adversely affect"). The critical operational reliance on banking partners for payment processing and client fund custody makes this an existential risk, amplified by counterparty default exposure. The Capital category is highly weighted here.

risks.title: Intense competition in payments
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited as "substantial and increasingly intense." The impact on margins and market share loss is clearly stated. The risk is stable but critical in a low-margin sector. The Competition category is heavily weighted in a technology context.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and data security
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned with strong language: "material harm to our reputation, business, financial condition." The risk is repeated and linked to customer trust. In the fintech sector, cybersecurity is existential. The Cybersecurity category has a high weight in IT.

risks.title: Payment services regulation
risks.score_rationale: The text refers to risks as "extensive and changing" with potentially severe sanctions (fines, suspension). Non-compliance with AML rules, trade sanctions, or card network requirements is repeated. Regulation is critical for operating licenses. High weighting.

risks.title: Decline in cross-border e-commerce
risks.score_rationale: The risk is highlighted as having a "material adverse effect," with concrete examples (tariffs 2025, China-U.S. tensions). Cross-border commerce is crucial for profitability. The language is concerning and the geopolitical context is tense. High Macro weighting.

risks.title: Dependence on the Chinese market
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention: "significant portion of our revenue is generated from China." The risk is new or reinforced compared to the prior year (not previously highlighted as a priority). The Geopolitical category is strongly weighted in the current U.S.-China context.

risks.title: Rapid technological change
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the introduction and repeated. Strong language: "rapidly evolving markets," "failure to adapt... could limit growth." Innovation (cryptocurrencies, AI) is vital. The Technology category is critical for an IT company. High weighting.

ai_positioning.summary: Payoneer Global Inc. does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
